_note: Zombie Villager (nqL-uL-Z_7I0iuowlpBDx). A live fight (director screenshot, 2026-10-26) shows every zombie doing Basic Attack then End Turn and never using Zombie Claws. Cause: the AI has aiProfileId null (push/262 read), so battles give it the shared admin-locked Default profile (combat.ts initiateBattle: aiProfileId ?? 'Default'), whose rules do not call the claws. This gives it its own profile (the builder toggles one first): use Zombie Claws when adjacent (range 1, gate 2), otherwise move in. No new moves, no kit or stat change. Claws cost 60 AP; the remaining 40 AP ends the turn.
